content.subject: ShipBob's $200M round and reconciliation
content.draft_text:
Hi Test,
ShipBob raised $200M. That level of growth often leads to intercompany reconciliation sprawl, which can strain manual processes and delay financial closing, especially when multiple warehouses and third‑party carriers are involved daily.
We build a platform that automatically matches and reconciles inbound and outbound shipment data across all fulfillment centers in real‑time.
Worth a 15-minute call next week?
